### Observed differences

- A01 appears only in the later window: it occurs in 0 of 200 earlier traces but in 200 of 200 later traces, once per trace, at roughly 39% of the trace's length (mean position 0.392). [OCC001, POS001]
- In the later window A01 sits between A02 and A03: A02 precedes A01 in all later traces, and A01 precedes A03 and A07 in all later traces, while its order against A05 and A06 is mixed (A01 first in about 55 of 100 traces versus A05, about 49 versus A06). A01's outgoing transitions split between A05 (~39%), A03 (~34%) and A06 (~28%), and A02's outgoing transitions, previously only A05 (~51%) and A06 (~49%), now include A01 (~38%). [REL001, REL002, REL006, REL004, REL005, DIR001, DIR002]
- A04 disappears: it occurs in all 200 earlier traces (at about 80% of the trace's length, always followed by A07) and in 0 of 200 later traces; its co-occurrence with A02, A03, A05, A06 and A07 drops from every trace to none. [OCC002, POS003, DIR004, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011]
- A03 now leads directly to A07: its outgoing transitions shift from only A04 (100%) in the earlier window to only A07 (100%) in the later window, and the A03→A07 step distance falls from always 2 steps to always 1. [DIR003, LAG004]
- Downstream timing shifts: A03's mean position moves from 0.6 to 0.8 of the trace; A05 and A06 move from ~0.30 to ~0.40 with wider spread; the A02→A03 distance grows from always 3 steps to always 4; distances from A02 to A05/A06 and from A05/A06 to A03 reach 3 steps in about a third of later cases (before at most 2); distances from A05/A06 to A07 now start at 2 steps (before 3–4); and A05/A06, previously always adjacent, are 2 steps apart in about 21–35% of later cases. [POS002, POS004, POS005, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG005, LAG008, LAG006, LAG009, LAG007, LAG010]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the segment between A02 and A07 was restructured: A01, unobserved in the earlier window, is executed in every later trace after A02 and before A03, interleaved with the existing A05/A06 block, while A04, executed in every earlier trace, is no longer observed, and A03 now leads directly to A07 instead of through A04. [OCC001, OCC002, POS001, POS003, DIR001, DIR003, DIR004, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006]

The signs are direct and consistent: the participation of A01 and A04 flips between 0 and 100% on samples of 200 traces per window, A03's only outgoing transition changes from A04 to A07 with the step distance falling from 2 to 1, and 34 control-flow items qualified against roughly 0.17 expected for an unchanged process, so chance sampling cannot account for the pattern as a whole. [OCC001, OCC002, DIR003, LAG004]

Limitations: the evidence cannot show whether the appearance of A01 and the disappearance of A04 were one coordinated redesign or two separate modifications, nor can it distinguish a redesigned process from a complete switch from one variant to another; A04's zero participation only means it was not observed in the later window. [OCC002]

Other differences: none beyond the shifts above — the later positions and step distances of A03, A05 and A06 follow from the insertion of A01 and the removal of A04 rather than being independent changes. [POS002, POS004, POS005, LAG002, LAG007]
